en: The Dharani of the Great, Perfect, and Unobstructed Compassionate Heart of the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara with a Thousand Hands and a Thousand Eyes, Scroll One.

Posthumously Enfeoffed as Grand Master of the Court of the Imperial Household (Kaifu Yitongsi) during the Great Tang Dynasty, with the posthumous title Da Hongjiao (Great Propagator of the Teachings).
